acceptance_gate.condition: positive_control_confirmed true AND a_vs_b_delta + a_vs_b_ci95 reported (verifier_label_carries_signal resolved), OR an honest accumulating/invalid/retired verdict

field_principles.a_vs_b_ci95: Task-level bootstrap CI95 of the A-vs-B delta -- excluding 0 distinguishes a real lift from the spurious-reward floor.
field_principles.a_vs_b_delta: pass@1(certified A) - pass@1(random-label B) on held-out hidden tests -- isolates the verifier's LABEL from the generator's intelligence (arXiv:2506.10947 / 2509.20837 open question).
field_principles.accumulated_n: Running total eval N across windows (resume-accumulate) -- a single window adding tasks is PROGRESS; the accumulate-floor auto-retires only after 3 no-usable windows.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A clean 'label carries signal', a clean 'A~=B distillation null', and an honest 'accumulating/underpowered' are ALL COMPLETE -- the project's first clean verifier-as-reward read either way.
field_principles.model_specs: The NON-Qwen base + the on-policy generator; required methodology for a live-LLM training artifact.
field_principles.positive_control_confirmed: BARE bool: gold-control (Arm C >= base) AND truncation_rate<5% on all arms -- without these the A-vs-B number is INVALID, not a finding.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; torch generation + LoRA init seeded so the run is reproducible across windows.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the corpora + LoRA config; lets a third party confirm the same training inputs.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=true -- HONEST: the reward is the execution oracle (RLVR/RLEF reward axis), NOT a moat claim; declaring it true keeps the result out of the oracle-distinct headline lane (Circularity Discipline).
field_principles.verifier_label_carries_signal: BARE bool: a_vs_b_ci95 excludes 0 AND delta>0 -- the de-confounded answer to the operator's pivot. NOT a_vs_cold_base (that conflates the verifier's label with the spurious-reward confound).
field_principles.youden_j: BARE float TPR-FPR of the execution certifier vs hidden-pass -- the arXiv:2601.04411 precondition; an exact execution label should show J>>0.

a1_operating_point.corpus: HumanEval Exp1999 deterministic 10-task headroom slice + EvalPlus visible/hidden label checkpoint
